span.p:
Marking vocabulary - served at runtime by /api/config
Levels OPEN < PARTNER < INTERNAL < RESTRICTED
Compartments TTW, MER - B2B sub-compartment TTW/NWL
fictional, ACME's own - the base library carries no vocabulary

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dominance rule
a subject may read a row when its level dominates the row's level
AND its compartment set contains every compartment on the row
